Privacy Policy

Last updated: July 2026

1. Overview

Anna.I Pte. Ltd. ("Anna.I", "we", "us") operates a home-services coordination platform for households in Singapore. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA) of Singapore.

2. Data we collect

We collect: (a) account data — name, email, phone number; (b) household data — home type, address, schedule, service preferences; (c) transaction data — job bookings, payments, vendor interactions; (d) verification data — photos confirming job completion.

3. How we use your data

We use your data to: match you with vetted vendors, schedule and coordinate jobs, hold payment in escrow and release on verification, remember your preferences across bookings, and resolve disputes. We do not sell your data to third parties.

4. Data retention

We retain your data for as long as your account is active. You may request deletion of your account and associated data at any time by emailing hello@annai.sg. Transaction records are retained for 7 years for legal and tax compliance.

5. Your rights

Under PDPA, you have the right to access, correct, or withdraw consent for processing your personal data. To exercise these rights, contact us at hello@annai.sg.

6. Contact

For privacy inquiries, email hello@annai.sg. We respond within one business day.
